result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 0 against the story FCs, tech-design storage/config/fixture/seam requirements, and test-plan substrate mapping. Audited the changed runtime code and Story 0 tests, then ran the configured story and epic gates from packages/lhc; both passed.

verified: FC-0.1: v6 DDL defines thread_view, thread_view_band, and view_boundary with CHECK constraints and boundary seed at position 0 in src/shared/storage.ts:91-119; migration v6 is registered after v5 in src/domains/threads/internal/create.ts:122-128; thread-migration.test.ts:345-433 verifies Epic-02-file upgrade and reapply no-op.

TC substrate evidence: seedViewBoundary for TC-1.4 is present in test/fixtures/view-seam.ts:18-40; compact-write and post-commit-advance injection points for TC-2.4 and TC-4.6 are present in seam.ts:13-34; G4 straggler substrate is present in view-thread.ts:256-260 and verified in view-fixture.test.ts:291-322.

Definition of Done: check-boundaries.mjs:61-77 pins the thread-view allowed imports and intake-stream -> thread-view sanctioned cycle; fixture helpers live under test/fixtures with sanctioned below-SDK comments; Story gate and Epic gate passed.

additionalObservations: Real-code workaround audit found no material fake adapters, shim branches, fallback runtime paths, or placeholder runtime behavior in Story 0 code. The deterministic provider is confined to test fixture setup.
The actual seam call sites are future Story 2 and Story 4 work; Story 0 scope excludes thread-view operations and currently supplies the named no-op substrate.
